name: iOS Simulator
description: Adds Cindy's Host-owned embedded iOS Simulator workflow. WDA, H.264, HID, lifecycle, admission, ownership, recovery, and fallback remain Host-managed; external Xcode/Simulator/simctl is allowed only on an explicitly authorized fallback route with no Cindy-owned runtime active.
whenToUse: Prefer Cindy's embedded simulator. Fallback only when Host reports unavailable/disabled or admission failure, confirms runningInstanceCount=0 with no Cindy runtime, cleanup, lease, or generation transition, and supplies an external workflow, exact device identity, and original task; otherwise stop.
author: Cindy

items.name: cindy-ios-simulator
items.description: Use Cindy's Host-owned embedded iOS Simulator for app build, launch, inspection, and interaction; use external Xcode/Simulator/simctl only on a Host-authorized fallback route when no Cindy-owned runtime is active.
